description:
Search Streaming Radar articles, or — with mode=coverage — check whether a topic is already covered in the published corpus using semantic similarity.

mode=search (default): case-insensitive substring match of the WHOLE query on title, subtitle and editorial_angle of published articles only. This is not full-text search: a multi-word query matches only if those words appear together, in that order, as one phrase. Use short queries (one or two words). Free access, no API key required.
mode=coverage: semantic anti-redite + auto-citation check over the published corpus. Returns a channel-weighted verdict (DÉJÀ TRAITÉ / EFFLEURÉ / NEUF — only PUBLISHED pieces can block; briefs are non-blocking signals), plus citable hits (url + excerpt) for self-citation. Also returns a facts array: passages already published in the body of a piece that carry the same rare terms as the query (non-blocking). Free access.

channels.description: mode=coverage only — restrict to channels (substack, linkedin_story, linkedin_post, guest_article, vdtv, brief). Default: all.

mode.description: search (default) = case-insensitive substring match on title, subtitle and editorial angle (not full-text) | coverage = semantic corpus coverage check

query.description: mode=search: text matched as one contiguous, case-insensitive substring (e.g. "Canal+"; "Netflix Africa" only matches where those two words are adjacent). mode=coverage: free-text description of the angle or topic to check (a sentence is fine).

top_k.description: Number of vector neighbours to retrieve (default 10, max 30) — mode=coverage only

name: sr_search_articles
